data.name: Slot Siege
data.detailed_description:
There’s a very nice slot machine and everyone wants to smash it. If it gets destroyed, game over.

Slot Siege is a frantic co-op defense game where your survival depends entirely on how much you’re willing to bet. You’ve got 10 nights to hold the line against increasingly difficult enemies.

Gamble or Die

You don’t just buy gear, You spin for it. Spend your hard-earned gold on the machine to get items, weapons, and buffs. You might get a turret that clears the screen, or you might get a total dud while a horde of enemies is five feet from your face.

Bring Your Friends

Don’t suffer alone. Team up with your buddies to coordinate your defenses and share resources.

The 10-Night Gauntlet

Every day gets worse. The enemies get faster, the waves get bigger, and the stakes get higher. If you can make it past night 10, you win. If not? Well, there's always the next run.

data.short_description: Keep the machine spinning and the walls standing. Slot Siege is a chaotic co-op defense game where you gamble your gold for gear and upgrades. Fight off hordes, scavenge resources, and try to survive 10 days of RNG-fueled madness with your friends. Don't go broke. Don't die.
